name: stormwatch
description: Stormwatch: open-source live hurricane tracker you run on your own computer (informational only)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: npm run build -w web && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
